title: Sleepy Princess
description: A princess falls into a deep slumber after eating a witch’s poisoned apple. Legend says only true love’s kiss can awaken her.
quote: Thank you good witch, you’re as kind as you are ugly. Very, very kind indeed.
alt1: witch hand holding an apple with skull and cross bones on it
alt2: witch next to the princess who is flat on her face, apple resting on her butt
alt4: the king and a troll holding an axe
